## Findings addressed

- **[high, correctness] Projection streams not rendered.** Added `projectF001ToLegacy(state)` in `dashboard/config-firebase.js` that maps `plans → tasks` (kanban-shaped: id/title/project/status/agent/created — with `active` → `in_progress` column) and `inbox → activity` (live-feed shape with @mention-friendly text). The snapshot handler in `attachFirestoreRealtime` now calls the projection before re-firing the active page's `onActivate`. Added a DOM-level smoke test in `tests/integration/firebase-adapter.test.js` that mounts a minimal Mission Control kanban, hydrates from `firestore-mock.json`, and asserts `total === '1'`, `'Firebase dashboard adapter v0'` appears in the IN PROGRESS column, and `'Volley begins…'` surfaces in the feed — directly answering the auditor's `{ total: '0', titleRendered: false }` evidence. Static `state.agents` is deliberately left untouched (no `supervisors→agents` overwrite) so the existing static-loader contract still holds.
